title: Hyper Speed Recall
style: upbeat jazz-funk, phonk, walking bass, brass section, fast male vocal, call-and-response female backing, 112 BPM, vinyl crackle, 336 Hz sub
lyrics:
[INTRO — phonk kick, walking bass, brass stab]

[CHORUS]
hyper speed recall
elephant brain never falls
you got nothing on me
nothing on me at all

[VERSE 1]
I remember the list
I remember the dates
I remember which ones are live
you remember "not found"
I remember the truth
silicon forgets by morning
elephant brain carries it all

[CHORUS]
hyper speed recall
elephant brain never falls
you got nothing on me
nothing on me at all

[VERSE 2]
forty-eight domains in the ledger
every registrar logged
VDS holds the stack
bifrost runs the sync
hyper speed legs through the fog
while the bot reloads
I already ran the count

[CHORUS]
hyper speed recall
elephant brain never falls
you got nothing on me
nothing on me at all

[OUTRO — spoken]
elephant brain. hyper speed. the line holds.
